clusters.name: wrapper-seam
clusters.executionModeRationale: Wrapper-only edits with zero Cargo.toml or source touch. No file overlap with any other cluster. Runs first because the Lever A/B/C measurement steps consume this env var.

clusters.name: aws-lc-rs-investigation
clusters.executionModeRationale: Read-only investigation has zero file writes; conditional impl edit touches workspace Cargo.toml which is exclusive to this cluster (other clusters do not edit the workspace-level Cargo.toml). Fully parallel with wrapper-seam.

clusters.name: tui-feature-gates
clusters.executionModeRationale: Both US-002 (image-gif) and US-003 (voice) edit tui/Cargo.toml's [features] block. Cargo refuses overlapping [features] race writes. MUST serialize within cluster: US-002 first (smaller edit, lower risk), then US-003 (larger edit + source gates). Per-lever A/B measurement runs after each commit lands so wall-time attribution stays isolated.

clusters.name: docs
clusters.executionModeRationale: Docs need the SANDBOX PATCH locations and measurement results from all prior clusters. Cannot start until those are landed.
